mapper.sql: select m.module_id, m.module_name, m.module_key, m.root_menu_id, m.status, m.is_core, m.order_num, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, (select count(*) from sys_role r where r.module_key = m.module_key and r.del_flag = '0') as role_count, (select count(*) from sys_job j where j.module_key = m.module_key) as job_count from sys_module m
mapper.update: update sys_role set status = '1', remark = concat(ifnull(remark, ''), ' [模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']') where module_key = #{moduleKey} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and ifnull(remark, '') not like concat('%[模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']%')

update sys_role set status = '0', remark = replace(ifnull(remark, ''), concat(' [模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']'), '') where module_key = #{moduleKey} and ifnull(remark, '') like concat('%[模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']%')

update sys_job set status = '1', remark = concat(ifnull(remark, ''), ' [模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']') where module_key = #{moduleKey} and status = '0' and ifnull(remark, '') not like concat('%[模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']%')

update sys_job set status = '0', remark = replace(ifnull(remark, ''), concat(' [模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']'), '') where module_key = #{moduleKey} and ifnull(remark, '') like concat('%[模块停用:', #{moduleKey}, ']%')
